lead.t: Lung cancer is a malignant tumour arising from the bronchial epithelium (bronchogenic carcinoma).

snip.t: Lung cancer is a malignant tumour arising from the bronchial epithelium (bronchogenic carcinoma).
Bronchogenic carcinoma is more\ncommon in individuals with asbestos exposure, particularly when there is a history of smoking.
Lung abscesses are found in 10–15% of patients with bronchogenic carcinoma, so an underlying carcinoma must be considered in older adults with lung abscess.
Blood mixed with purulence (bronchiectasis, pneumonia), frank blood clots (cavitary TB, bronchogenic carcinoma, pulmonary infarction), blood-streaked (bronchitis).
